saved_draft_mail: Draft version saved — notification email sent.
notify_warn: Draft saved, but the notification email could not be sent: {{detail}}
published: Final version published on the site.
publishing_i18n: Publishing and translating into the 5 languages…
published_i18n: Final version published in {{locales}}. A confirmation email has been sent.
publish_notify_warn: Published, but the confirmation email could not be sent: {{detail}}
draft_banner: Draft version — pending final validation. Visible only to the lawyer and general admin. Highlighted comments are not public.
comment_need_edit: Switch to Edit mode to annotate the text.
comment_need_selection: Select a word, sentence or paragraph first.
comment_added: Comment added (remember to save the draft).
comments_help: Click a yellow highlight or a card to open the review popup.
comments_empty: No comments yet. Switch to Edit, select a passage, then “Comment selection”.
comment_missing: No comment linked to this highlight.
review_validated_local: Comment validated — save the draft to confirm.
comment_deleted_local: Comment deleted — save the draft to confirm.
quote_applied: Highlighted text updated in the document.
mark_not_found: Highlight not found in the document.
